items.cite: Daniel Albright, ed., *Modernism and Music: An Anthology of Sources* (University of Chicago Press, 2004).
items.note: Brings composers’ and critics’ writings together with musical arguments by poets, novelists and philosophers.

items.cite: Joseph Auner, *Music in the Twentieth and Twenty-First Centuries* (W. W. Norton, 2013).
items.note: Sets compositional developments beside war, social upheaval, technological change and changing relations between composers and listeners.
